title: Men's Christmas – Drew Your Name. Panicked. Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Office Christmas Sweatshirt – Drew Your Name. Panicked.
seo.description: Office Christmas sweatshirt: a sweating 1950s office worker drew your name for Secret Santa. Men's unisex crewneck in Sand or Navy, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Every office Secret Santa in two beats: DREW YOUR NAME. Panicked. This office Christmas sweatshirt is for the guy who just pulled a coworker's name out of a Santa hat and has no idea what they like, and it makes gift-exchange night easier to survive.

The print is a 1950s office-party cartoon: a balding man in a short-sleeve shirt and narrow tie stares wide-eyed at the paper slip in his raised hand while sweat flies off his forehead, with an upturned red Santa hat full of folded slips and a clumsily taped gift with a crooked bow on the desk in front of him. DREW YOUR NAME. runs across the top in red slab capitals and Panicked. sits below in black script, both in cream on Navy.

Wear it to the office party, the break-room gift swap or any family drawing of names, or hand it to the coworker who takes the exchange too seriously: a funny Secret Santa gift that does not look like a gift card. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

How does the Drew Your Name. Panicked. crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomy, cozy look over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

What is it made of and how warm is it?
The Drew Your Name. Panicked. crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for a crowded office party. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand and Navy, both in sizes S through 3XL. On Sand the headline is red and the script black; on Navy both turn cream, with a cream outline around the cartoon so the linework stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order, and a misprint is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.

Is this a good gift for an office exchange?
Yes. The Drew Your Name. Panicked. crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. suits the coworker with a dry sense of humor, a brother or a dad who dreads the gift swap. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.

When should I order for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Drew Your Name. Panicked. crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. Orders of $45 or more ship free, and a misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
